	abort = { NOT = { has_country_flag = llmb_befriend_NOR } }
	ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "NOR" value = 150 }
}

llmb_befriend_NOR_strong = {
	enable = { has_country_flag = llmb_befriend_NOR has_global_flag = llmb_strong_directives }
	abort = { OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = llmb_befriend_NOR } NOT = { has_global_flag = llmb_strong_directives } } }
	ai_strategy = { type = befriend id = "NOR" value = 10000 }
}

	abort = { OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = llmb_ignore_PRU } NOT = { has_global_flag = llmb_strong_directives } } }
	ai_strategy = { type = ignore id = "PRU" value = 10000 }
}
